venira.output_kind: from, to, kind, overwritten, entries, bytes, skipped_symlinks/skipped_protected when any. Missing source gives not_found, an existing target without overwrite gives conflict.
venira.speed_profile: fast for files; directory copies scale with size. Clears the read/list/search cache.
venira.use_when: you duplicate a file or folder, for example to start from a template.

description:
Copy a file, or a directory with recursive=true, inside the workspace. overwrite=true replaces an existing file; symbolic links and protected files inside a directory are skipped.
Use when: you duplicate a file or folder, for example to start from a template.
Avoid when: you move or rename (move_path).
Output: from, to, kind, overwritten, entries, bytes, skipped_symlinks/skipped_protected when any. Missing source gives not_found, an existing target without overwrite gives conflict.

create_dirs.description: true creates missing parent directories of `to` (default true).

overwrite.description: true replaces an existing target file (default false). A directory is never replaced.

recursive.description: true is required to copy a directory (default false).

to.description: New workspace path: the final name, not a parent directory.

name: copy_path
title: Copy path
